name: Starter Rank Up Relic
description: Start every run with the "Card Rank Up!" relic (rankupcard:RankUp) from Rank Up Cards, and take it out of the act 1 relic drop pools while the player owns it. 1.3.0: removed the meaningless AbstractDungeon.player check in receivePostCreateStartingRelics, dropped the unreliable injectedThisRun static (reload-safe condition instead, actNum <= 1 because act 1 is 0), and replaced the RelicLibrary.getRelic() existence check with a null-safe languagePack.getRelicStrings() lookup. Keeps CUSTOM-1..CUSTOM-5 markers.
